_comment: Community-maintained headset profiles for VisionALVR's configure wizard (see docs/HMD_PROFILES.md). One entry per headset + client app. Only put values you have run and verified; say on what in `verified`. Pull requests welcome.

variants.label: Wi-Fi 6/6E, 5 or 6 GHz, strong signal, headset on the same subnet as the PC

notes: Full frame (no foveation) costs about 4-5 ms more encode time than foveated on an RTX 5090 (7.7 ms against 3.1 ms) and the NVENC load is higher, but the picture is sharper everywhere; the decoder time on the headset is about 1 ms lower.
The headset displays at 100 Hz while the stream is 90 fps: the host follows the headset's display rate.
Split encoding needs a GPU with several NVENC engines (RTX 4070 Ti and up, RTX 50 series).

verified.result: 100 fps rendered and streamed in Cyberpunk 2077, total latency about 117 ms (ALVR's measure), 0 packets lost
